name: https://arcaeon.io/adapter
description: A stdio proxy that sits between an MCP client and an MCP server, forwards JSON-RPC byte for byte, and writes one chained row per tools/call. The record is written at the wire, in a separate OS process, by something the agent is not consulted about and cannot skip. It sees the seam it is wrapping, and nothing else.

data.name: arcaeon-adapter
data.description: MCP stdio proxy that logs the tool-call seam to the ledger without the agent's cooperation
